transforms.search: function renderContextTray(){const tray=q("#gptPresenceContextTray");if(!tray)return;tray.hidden=!pinnedContexts.length;tray.innerHTML=pinnedContexts.map((c,i)=>`◉${esc(c.name||c.id)}${esc(c.type||"object")} · ${esc(c.id)}`).join("");tray.querySelectorAll(".gpt-context-chip").forEach(ch=>ch.addEventListener("click",e=>{if(e.target.closest("button"))return;B.executeTool?.("focus_object",{id:ch.dataset.contextId});ghostLookAt(ch.dataset.contextId,"Фокус на объекте")}));tray.querySelectorAll("[data-remove-context]").forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("click",e=>{e.stopPropagation();pinnedContexts.splice(Number(b.dataset.removeContext),1);saveChat();renderContextTray()}))}
